Name: Smorbus
Author: tuesday87
Description:
This is my first mod! I just wanted to make this mod to see if I'm able to code a mod and it was successful! I wasn't planning on uploading it, but I decided it'd be useful to upload this mod first so I know what to do when I want to upload a serious mod.

Here's the tutorial I used to make Smorbus: https://stardewmodding.miraheze.org/wiki/Tutorial:_Adding_New_Dialogue

Downloads.Description: Smorbus, now updated for 1.6! It might be a little wonky, though.
